changes_made.explanation: Removed GPT-4o as it's used for NE extraction, not generation. Normalized dataset names for consistency. Added missing Jinghpaw Reader dataset.
Normalized TQS-MQM and TQS MQM variants to base MQM metric. All metrics are used to evaluate MT outputs.
No LLMs were used as judges for evaluation. GPT-4o was only used for named entity extraction, not for judging generated outputs.

guideline: Annotators categorize sentence pairs using labels: Correct, Wrong grammar, Wrong punctuation, Wrong spelling, Wrong capitalization, Inaccurate addition, Inaccurate omission, Mistranslation, Unnatural translation, Untranslated text, Wrong register
Multiple labels can be selected per sentence
Error severity categorized into Critical, Major, Minor errors
Annotators provide corrected translations and free-form comments
